goal: Let RPC callers request fee rates in sat/vB across fee and network estimation endpoints
Eliminates manual conversion friction and avoids sub-1 sat/vB rounding errors for downstream apps
agreement: Concept approval for backwards-compatible migration to sat/vB (musaHaruna)
Earlier objections on float precision and unit consistency were resolved (maflcko, w0xlt)
Open request to update description if no longer a proof of concept (willcl-ark)

categories.name: rpc
why: P2 because it eliminates manual unit conversions for downstream applications and users
It prevents rounding errors that distort sub-1 sat/vB fee rate estimations
